services.desc: Stone Pass Outfitters is owned by Justin Frie and Caleb Halverson.. They are dedicated to providing quality outdoor experience for those wishing to experience the San Juan Forest and Weminuche Wilderness areas. The base of operations is located near the heart of the Rocky Mountains north of Pagosa Springs. They offer high country trail rides and pack trips, big game hunts, and daily horseback rides spring, summer and fall. services.name: Creede Historical Mining Tour
services.desc: Learn all about the rich history of southern Colorado with our Creede Mining Tour! Head over to Creede with a knowledgeable guide and make stops at the incredible scenic and historic stops along the way. Learn about how the old miners lived. services.name: Half Day Custom Pagosa Scenic Wildlife Tour
services.desc: The Pagosa Springs area is surrounded by some of the most beautiful and intriguing natural wonders of the Four Corners area. Our knowledgeable guides will take you to some of their favorite hideaways! Each tour is uniquely catered to your interests. Interested in the scenic views? We have the perfect places for that. Want to see the wildlife we have here? We know where they tend to hang out. Into history? Our area is rich with it. Want a little bit of everything? We can do that too. services.name: Pagosa Peak Hike
services.desc: # >Tour departs in early morning from our office, located inside of the Pagosa Lodge, [3505 US Highway 160, Pagosa Springs, CO 81147.] (https://goo.gl/maps/3kUMvPCeUnNuuEZR8) We'll have an adventure on the way through the trailhead over an old 4x4 logging road as we wind up the mountain through the beautiful aspen, spruce and fir forests. Then, we'll set off on foot, following the elk and game trails as we move up into the high forest. Our pace will be leisurely to allow for the rugged terrain. Marmots, golden eagles and mule deer are abundant on the mountains, and we might even get a Hike to the top of Pagosa Peak
